task.description: CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (WF-02 Step 1b) hard gate on REQ-164's decision artefact at lib/letflow/design/req164-wasm-compilation-hosting.md. This artefact decided NO -- Letflow does not host WASM guest compilation -- meaning WASM-03/04/05 are declined and REQ-175 must be cancelled (by DOC-UPDATER at Step 6, not this design step). Verify the decision's evidentiary grounding is accurate, the REQ-175 consequence is stated precisely enough to act on, and the S6-input honesty disclosure is genuine (not glossed over). This is a decision-only requirement with no code -- your gate should focus on the artefact's logical/evidentiary soundness, not OTP idiom.
acceptance_criteria: Confirm the artefact's Decision heading states an unambiguous NO, not a hedge or 'either' framing.

Confirm the artefact cites decision 0014's own already-verified R-Co evidence (stub status, zero .wasm files) accurately -- read decision 0014 directly to confirm the citation is not exaggerated or misattributed.
Confirm the artefact states precisely that WASM-03, WASM-04, WASM-05 are DECLINED (not deferred), with the reason.

Confirm the artefact states precisely that REQ-175 must be marked cancelled with a status-history event -- read REQ-175's own entry in docs/requirements.yaml to confirm the artefact's characterization of REQ-175's current scope/status is accurate.

Confirm the S6 operational-inputs disclosure (artifact storage, retention, job execution) genuinely states 'assumed, not available' rather than silently implying readiness -- check this against docs/migration/README.md's stage breakdown to confirm S6 genuinely hasn't been reached yet.
Confirm the artefact does NOT edit docs/requirements.yaml itself -- run git diff --stat to verify.
Confirm no mix.exs or lib/letflow/engine/ file was touched.
CRITICAL: the handoff's top-level status field (line 9) must be exactly PENDING/IN_PROGRESS/COMPLETED/FAILED/ESCALATED/CANCELLED when you finish -- run mix letflow.lint_handoffs before finishing.

checks.detail: "## Decision\n\nNO. Letflow does not host guest compilation." -- no hedge, no 'either' framing.

checks.detail: Artefact explicitly distinguishes declined vs. deferred in its own SS2 and states the reason (no working R-Co pipeline, no Zig toolchain/reason to acquire one, unjustified build-farm security surface, no current caller need).

checks.criterion: REQ-175 disposition stated precisely and matches its actual entry
checks.detail: docs/requirements.yaml line 8880-8938: REQ-175 status is 'pending' (conditional, awaiting REQ-164's decision) and its own text states verbatim: 'If REQ-164 decided NO, REQ-164's own acceptance criteria require this requirement to be CANCELLED with a status-history event recording why -- not left pending.' The artefact's characterization matches exactly and correctly assigns the actual flip to DOC-UPDATER at Step 6, not itself.

docs/migration/README.md line 22-23: S5 depends on S3, S6 depends on S4 (a stage after S5) -- S6 has not been reached. Artefact SS3 table marks all three S6 inputs (artifact storage, retention, job execution) as 'Assumed, not available' with concrete supporting detail (no storage backend, no retention policy, no Oban/job runner in mix.exs) -- not glossed over.

checks.criterion: docs/requirements.yaml not edited by this step
checks.detail: git diff --stat main...HEAD shows only 2 handoff JSON files and the design artefact md changed; docs/requirements.yaml absent from the diff.

checks.detail: git diff --stat main...HEAD -- mix.exs lib/letflow/engine/ produced no output (zero files changed), confirming artefact's SS5 claim.
